parsed.summary: After tracing power, the CAN/e-stop/USB/serial interfaces and the component values, the drawing implements the architecture the specification describes (CM4 carrier, MCP2515 CAN controllers with 16 MHz crystals and 120 R terminations, SN74LVC1G07 e-stop sink buffers, LTC4412xS6 ideal-diode with P-MOS, ISL54222 analog switches, WS2812B chain). The concerns the spec raises (USB diode, GLOBAL_EN sequencing, CAN-LED polarity, cable-disconnect e-stop, C5 footprint, 'are any switches backwards') are documented known issues/TODOs and are not reported; the README RS-485-vs-CAN note is a documentation discrepancy, not a board deviation. Reference designators differ between the spec's reference build and this build (e.g. CAN controllers are U4/U10/U24/U25 here vs U8/U9 in the spec), but no functional deviation that would change board behaviour is supported by the drawing, so I report no anomaly.
